title: 1. What this document is
body:
These terms govern the use of Quilax: the mobile app, the game website and Wallet (money management).
By using the service you accept these terms and the Privacy Policy.
Last updated: July 25, 2026.
Contact only within the app (Help / tickets).

title: 2. Who provides the service
body:
Quilax is a competitive quiz platform with prizes in credits.
Operated by Vicente de Silva Ortiz, in pre-launch phase (no company incorporated yet). When a company is formed, its legal name, tax ID and registered address will be updated here.
Contact only within the app (Support via tickets).

title: 3. What you can do on Quilax
body:
• Play live or scheduled quizzes.
• Join by paying the entry fee in credits.
• Create quizzes (if you meet the requirements), subject to review.
• Check rankings, messages, profile and help.
• Deposit and withdraw only from the Wallet website.
This is not a casino: the outcome depends on knowledge, speed and accuracy.

title: 4. Age and who can use the app
body:
You must be at least 18 years old to deposit, join paid quizzes and withdraw.
Minors cannot use money-related flows. We may request age or identity verification.

title: 5. Your account
body:
Provide accurate data; keep your password and 2FA safe; don't share your account.
One person = one account. Abusive multi-accounting is prohibited.
We may limit, suspend or close accounts due to fraud or risk.
You can request account closure/deletion via support, subject to legally required retention.

title: 6. Credits: what they are
body:
A unit of value within Quilax. Usual reference: 1 credit ≈ 1 euro.
Used for entries, prizes and available balance according to Wallet rules.
They are not a traditional bank deposit outside Quilax, except for the right to request a withdrawal under these terms.

title: 7. How a quiz works (game rules)
body:
Entry: usually 1 credit; charged when you join; non-refundable unless a technical error is proven.
Only approved/scheduled/published quizzes can be joined.
It's best to be on screen with time to spare before the start, with a stable connection.
Phases are controlled by the server; the live ranking may be approximate.
When it ends, the official standings and payout are set.

title: 8. Prizes, pool and payout
body:
According to the quiz's prize rules (positions and percentages). There may be a share for winners, the platform, the creator and the jackpot/season.
We may void or withhold prizes for bots, multi-accounting, collusion, serious failures or pending KYC when applicable.

title: 9. Seasons, ranking and jackpot
body:
Typical seasons last 45 days. Ranking and possible payouts (including jackpot) follow that season's rules.
If there's a conflict between a promotional message and the technical close, the closing/published rules prevail.

title: 10. Creating quizzes
body:
They require review. Until approved, they don't appear publicly and no one can join.
After rejection (or approval with a message from the admin) you can write to the Admin Panel within the indicated window (usually 72 h).
You are responsible for the content of your questions.

title: 11. Deposits (Wallet)
body:
Only on the Wallet website. The mobile app doesn't process cards (for security).
Usual processor: Stripe. You also accept its terms.

title: 12. Withdrawals
body:
From Wallet to a verified bank account. May require KYC, 2FA and anti-fraud review.
Bank processing times vary. We may delay, hold or reject suspicious withdrawals.

title: 13. Identity verification (KYC)
body:
Official document, selfie/liveness check and consistent bank details.
Documents belonging to others or falsified documents: prohibited. Anti-money-laundering measures may apply where relevant.

title: 14. Refunds, errors and chargebacks
body:
Quiz entry is non-refundable unless a technical error is proven.
Incorrect charges: contact support with proof.
Abusive chargebacks may lead to suspension. Prizes paid by mistake may be reversed.

title: 15. Notifications and game alerts
body:
In-app and push alerts if you enable the permission.
Countdown after joining: 2 days, 1 day, 2 h, 1 h, 30 min, 10 min, 5 min and 1 min before the start.
We recommend not disabling the countdown alerts. Tapping a quiz alert opens that match.
Preferences: Settings → Notifications.

title: 16. Social content, messages and support
body:
Respectful language. Harassment, spam and illegal content are prohibited.
You can block and report. Support is available via Help, FAQ and tickets (no 24/7 guarantee).
General notices can't be replied to like a private chat.

title: 17. Prohibited conduct
body:
Cheating, bots, collusion, multi-accounting, security attacks, money laundering, phishing and IP infringement.
This may result in loss of prizes, suspension or account closure.

title: 18. Intellectual property
body:
Quilax's software and brand are protected.
You retain rights to your original content; you grant a license to host and operate it within the service.

title: 19. Service availability and changes
body: We don't guarantee uninterrupted service. We may modify features and rules with reasonable notice when relevant.

title: 20. Limitation of liability
body:
To the extent permitted by law: we are not liable for indirect damages, user disconnections, or third-party failures (network, banks, Stripe).
Mandatory consumer rights are not limited.
If a serious fault on our part is proven, liability may be limited to the affected operation.

title: 21. Cookies and similar technologies
body:
On the website: cookies/session and security storage.
In the app: local storage (session, preferences).
Disabling essential storage may prevent login or payments.

title: 22. Responsible gaming
body:
Set spending and time limits. If use stops being healthy, stop depositing and contact support.
We may apply limits in response to risk patterns.

title: 23. Suspension and cancellation
body:
We may suspend or cancel accounts due to breach, security or legal reasons.
Legitimate balance pending withdrawal is subject to verification; it may be withheld in case of dispute/fraud.

title: 24. Changes to these terms
body: We may update this document. Relevant changes will be communicated in the app or by email when reasonable.

title: 25. Governing law and complaints
body:
Spanish law applies. Mandatory EU consumer rights apply where relevant.
Complaints and privacy matters: only via tickets within the app. The Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) if applicable.

title: 26. Contact
body:
• Settings → Help center
• Settings → FAQ
• Settings → Support (tickets)
